summary: Ferroglobe PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on June 17, 2026. All resolutions were passed by poll, including receipt of accounts, approval of remuneration report, authorization for political donations, re-election of directors, and re-appointment of auditor KPMG LLP. Voting results show high support for most resolutions, with the remuneration report receiving 71.00% for and 27.29% against. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms, premiums, or special-situation mechanics are present.
